title: Annapurna Ashtakam
intro: Read Annapurna Ashtakam lyrics in Hindi and English with meaning. Discover the spiritual benefits of chanting this sacred stotram by Adi Shankaracharya for abundance and prosperity.
description:
nityanandakari varabhayakari saundaryaratnakari
nirdhutakhilaghorapavanakari pratyakshamaheshvari । (ghorapapanikari)
praleyachalavamshapavanakari kashipuradhishvari
bhiksham dehi kripavalambanakari mata annapurneshvari || 1 ||

nanaratnavichitrabhushanakari hemambaradambari
muktaharavilambamana vilasat vakshojakumbhantari ।
kashmiragaruvasita ruchikari kashipuradhishvari
bhiksham dehi kripavalambanakari mata annapurneshvari || 2 ||

yoganandakari ripukshayakari dharmarthanishthakari
chandrarkanalabhasamanalahari trailokyarakshakari ।
sarvaishvaryasamastavanchhitakari kashipuradhishvari
bhiksham dehi kripavalambanakari mata annapurneshvari || 3 ||

kailasachalakandaralayakari gauri uma shankari
koumari nigamarthagocharakari omkarabijakshari ।
mokshadvarakapatapatanakari kashipuradhishvari
bhiksham dehi kripavalambanakari mata annapurneshvari || 4 ||

drishyadrishya vibhutivahanakari brahmandabhandodari
lilanatakasutrabhedanakari vigyanadipankuri ।
shrivishweshamanah prasadanakari kashipuradhishvari
bhiksham dehi kripavalambanakari mata annapurneshvari || 5 ||

urvi sarvajneshvari bhagavati mata annapurneshvari
veninilasamankuntaladhari nityannadaneshvari ।
sarvanandakari sadashubhakari kashipuradhishvari
bhiksham dehi kripavalambanakari mata annapurneshvari || 6 ||

aadikshantasamastavarnanakari shambhostribhavakari
kashmira trijaleshvari trilahari nityankura sharvari ।
kamakankshakari janodayakari kashipuradhishvari
bhiksham dehi kripavalambanakari mata annapurneshvari || 7 ||

devi sarvavichitratranarachita dakshayani sundari
vame svadupayodhara priyakari saubhagya maheshvari ।
bhaktabhishtakari sadashubhakari kashipuradhishvari
bhiksham dehi kripavalambanakari mata annapurneshvari || 8 ||

chandrarkanalakotikotisadriksha chandranshubimbadhari
chandrarkagnisamanakundaladhari chandrarkavarneshvari ।
malapustakapashasankushadhari kashipuradhishvari
bhiksham dehi kripavalambanakari mata annapurneshvari || 9 ||

kshatratranakari mahabhayakari mata kripasagari
sakshanmokshakari sada shivakari vishweshvari shridhari ।
dakshakrandakari niramayakari kashipuradhishvari
bhiksham dehi kripavalambanakari mata annapurneshvari || 10 ||

annapurna sadapurna shankarapranavallabhe ।
jnanavairagyasiddhyartham bhiksham dehi cha parvati || 11 ||

mata me parvati devi pita devo maheshvarah ।
bandhavah shivabhaktashcha swadesho bhuvanatrayam || 12 ||

॥ Iti Shri Shankarabhagavatah Kritau Annapurnastotram Sampurnam ॥

faq.a1: Annapurna Ashtakam is a sacred, powerful hymn dedicated to Goddess Annapurna, an incarnation of Goddess Parvati and the divine provider of food, nourishment, and universal abundance.
faq.a2: This divine stotram was composed by the great philosopher and saint, Adi Shankaracharya.
faq.q3: What are the spiritual and material benefits of chanting Annapurna Ashtakam?
faq.a3: Regular recitation of Annapurna Ashtakam ensures that a household never faces a scarcity of food, wealth, or basic necessities. Spiritually, it invokes the grace of the goddess to bestow divine wisdom (Gyana), detachment (Vairagya), and mental peace.
faq.q4: When is the best time to recite Annapurna Ashtakam?
faq.a4: It can be chanted daily during morning prayers or right before cooking and offering food. Reciting it on auspicious occasions like Akshaya Tritiya, Annakoot, and Fridays is considered highly beneficial.
faq.q5: In which language is Annapurna Ashtakam originally written?
faq.a5: Annapurna Ashtakam is originally written in Sanskrit, but it is widely read and chanted in Hindi, English, and other regional languages using transliterated lyrics.
